en.headline: MTR reports mass fare evasion at Tsim Sha Tsui station to police
en.dek: A viral video showed groups of people tailgating through exit gates after a single card tap on 23 August; the operator said it has stepped up patrols and will pursue prosecutions where appropriate.
body: The MTR Corporation said on Tuesday it had reported a suspected mass fare-evasion incident at Tsim Sha Tsui station to police after reviewing surveillance footage of events on the evening of 23 August.

Online video circulating this week appeared to show a woman, described by viewers as a tour guide, tapping a card at an exit gate, after which multiple people filed through without tapping. In successive sequences, groups of four, seven, four, two and two people were seen exiting behind a single payment, with the gate indicator flashing red. No station staff were visible intervening in the footage.

Police said they received a report from MTR staff on 5 September stating that 36 people had attempted to follow one person through the gates. The case has been classified for miscellaneous follow-up. The MTR Corporation strongly condemned the behaviour, saying any failure to pay the correct fare breaches its by-laws and may result in a surcharge or prosecution. It said it would increase station patrols and urged passengers to alert staff promptly if they observe suspected breaches.

zh.headline: 港鐵尖沙咀站集體逃票報警 片段顯示一次拍卡多人出閘
zh.dek: 網上片段顯示8月23日晚有人拍一次卡後多人尾隨出閘，最多一次達7人；港鐵已報警並加強巡查，強調逃票可被檢控。
body: 港鐵公司周二表示，經翻查閉路電視後，已就尖沙咀站懷疑集體逃票事件向警方報案。事件相信發生於8月23日晚上約11時。
近日網上流傳片段顯示，一名疑似導遊的女子在出閘機拍卡後，隨即有多人魚貫尾隨出閘，沒有各自拍卡。片段錄得多組人潮，一次最多有7人在一次拍卡後出閘，閘機多次亮起紅燈示警。過程中未見車站職員即時介入。
警方稱於9月5日上午接獲港鐵職員報案，指當日有36人試圖跟隨一人出閘，案件列作雜項跟進。港鐵強烈譴責有關行為，指未繳付正確車資屬違反港鐵附例，可被徵收附加費甚至檢控。公司表示會加強車站巡查，並呼籲乘客發現可疑情況盡快通知職員。
